package.description: WorkBuddy（腾讯 AI 编程助手）多账号切换工具，支持账号切换、会话复制、自动签到、积分到期监控与 CodeBuddy CLI 自动轮换。

en-US.description: A multi-account switching tool for WorkBuddy (Tencent AI coding assistant) that supports account switching, session copying, automatic daily check-in, credit-expiry monitoring, and automatic CodeBuddy CLI rotation.
en-US.longDescription: workbuddy-switch is an account-switching tool for WorkBuddy (Tencent AI coding assistant), available as a desktop app (Tauri) and an npm webui. Multiple accounts share the same login state (workbuddy-desktop.info), letting you switch the active WorkBuddy login account in one click and copy the current account's sessions to a target account. It supports OAuth QR-code login, importing accounts from the local machine, or adding tokens manually; account switching that backs up the auth file, closes WorkBuddy, writes the target account, and restarts; copying the selected sessions of the current account to a target account under new ids; automatic daily check-in at a random moment within a configured time window; lazy token refresh and daily keep-alive; automatic queries of each account's credit resources, remaining balance, and expiry; independent CodeBuddy CLI switching and auto-rotation by credit urgency; and automatic updates from GitHub Releases.

zh-CN.description: WorkBuddy（腾讯 AI 编程助手）多账号切换工具，支持账号切换、会话复制、自动签到、积分到期监控与 CodeBuddy CLI 自动轮换。
zh-CN.longDescription: workbuddy-switch 是 WorkBuddy（腾讯 AI 编程助手）账号切换工具，提供桌面 App（Tauri）和 npm webui 两种形态。多账号共享登录态（workbuddy-desktop.info），一键切换 WorkBuddy 登录账号，并支持将当前账号的会话复制给目标账号。主要功能包括：OAuth 扫码登录、从本机导入或手动添加账号；备份认证文件、关闭 WorkBuddy、写入目标账号并重启的账号切换；将当前账号勾选的会话以新 id 复制给目标账号；每日在配置时间段内随机时刻自动签到；Token 惰性刷新与每日保活；自动查询每个账号的积分资源、剩余量和到期时间；CodeBuddy CLI 独立切换与按积分紧迫度自动轮换；配置 GitHub Releases 源自动更新。
zh-CN.name: workbuddy-switch
